arxiv-2107-11277.title: Machine Learning with a Reject Option: A survey
arxiv-2107-11277.creator: Hendrickx Kilian*, Perini Lorenzo*, Van der Plas Dries, Meert Wannes, Davis Jesse
arxiv-2107-11277.description: Abstract Machine learning models always make a prediction, even when it is likely to be inaccurate. This behavior should be avoided in many decision support applications, where mistakes can have severe consequences. Albeit already studied in 1970, machine learning with rejection recently gained interest.

arxiv-2210-15986.title: Differentially Private CutMix for Split Learning with Vision Transformer
arxiv-2210-15986.creator: Seungeun Oh, Sihun Baek, Hyelin Nam, Seong-Lyun Kim, Jihong Park, Praneeth Vepakomma, Ramesh Raskar, Mehdi Bennis
arxiv-2210-15986.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Seungeun Oh, Sihun Baek, Hyelin Nam, Seong-Lyun Kim, Jihong Park, Praneeth Vepakomma, Ramesh Raskar, Mehdi Bennis. Recently, vision transformer (ViT) has started to outpace the conventional CNN in computer vision tasks. Considering privacy-preserving distributed learning with ViT, federated learning (FL) communicates models, which becomes ill-suited due to ViT’s large model size and computing costs.

arxiv-2301-10414.title: Towards a Unification of Logic and Information Theory
arxiv-2301-10414.creator: Luis A. Lastras, Barry Trager, Jonathan Lenchner, Wojciech Szpankowski, Chai Wah Wu, Mark S. Squillante, Alexander Gray
arxiv-2301-10414.description: Abstract Today, the vast majority of the world’s digital information is represented using the fundamental assumption, introduced by Claude Shannon in 1948, that “…the semantic aspects of communication are irrelevant to the engineering problem (of the design of communication systems)…”.

arxiv-2303-16568.title: Quark mixing angles and weak CP-violating phase vs quark masses: potential approach
arxiv-2303-16568.description: Abstract Abstract: It is shown that following experimentally viable expressions for quark mixing angles \theta_{12} , \theta_{23} , \theta_{13} and CP-violating phase \delta : \sin\theta_{12}=\sqrt{m_{d}/|m_{s}|} , \sin\theta_{23}=2\,|m_{s}|/m_{b} , \sin\theta_{13}\approx 2\,m_{d}/m_{b} , \tan\delta=m_{b}^{2}\,m_{c}/6\,m_{t}\,m_{s}^{2} may be derived as stable points of certain 4-th power in V_{CKM} flavor-invariant potentials built with traces of 3x3 quark up and down mass matrices and the Jarlskog

arxiv-2304-04735.title: Stochastic Wave Dark Matter with Fermi-LAT γ \gamma -ray Pulsar Timing Array
arxiv-2304-04735.creator: Hoang Nhan Luu, Tao Liu, Jing Ren, Tom Broadhurst, Ruizhi Yang, Jie-Shuang Wang, Zhen Xie
arxiv-2304-04735.description: Abstract Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) can detect disturbances in the fabric of spacetime on a galactic scale by monitoring the arrival time of pulses from millisecond pulsars (MSPs). Recent advancements have enabled the use of γ \gamma -ray radiation emitted by MSPs, in addition to radio waves, for PTA experiments.

arxiv-2310-14610.title: That was the last straw, we need more: Are Translation Systems Sensitive to Disambiguating Context?
arxiv-2310-14610.creator: Jaechan Lee ♡ Alisa Liu ♡ Orevaoghene Ahia ♡ Hila Gonen ♡ Noah A. Smith ♡ ♣
arxiv-2310-14610.description: Abstract The translation of ambiguous text presents a challenge for translation systems, as it requires using the surrounding context to disambiguate the intended meaning as much as possible. While prior work has studied ambiguities that result from different grammatical features of the source and target language, we study semantic ambiguities that exist in the source (English in this work) itself.

arxiv-2404-04628.title: A refined convergence estimate for a fourth order finite difference numerical scheme to the Cahn-Hilliard equation
arxiv-2404-04628.creator: Jing Guo, Cheng Wang, Yue Yan, Xingye Yue
arxiv-2404-04628.description: Abstract In this article we present a refined convergence analysis for a second order accurate in time, fourth order finite difference numerical scheme for the 3-D Cahn-Hilliard equation, with an improved convergence constant. A modified backward differentiation formula temporal discretization is applied, and a Douglas-Dupont artificial regularization is included to ensure the energy stability.

arxiv-2405-03439.title: Anomalous Inverse Spin Hall Effect (AISHE) due to Unconventional Spin Currents in Ferromagnetic Films with Tailored Interfacial Magnetic Anisotropy
arxiv-2405-03439.creator: Soumik Aon, Harekrishna Bhunia, Abu Bakkar Miah, Dhananjaya Mahapatra, Partha Mitra, Pratap Kumar Pal, Anjan Barman
arxiv-2405-03439.description: Abstract A single layer ferromagnetic film magnetized in the plane of an ac current flow, exhibits a characteristic Hall voltage with harmonic and second harmonic components, which is attributed to the presence of spin currents with polarization non-collinear with the magnetization.

arxiv-2407-18091.title: On-shell effective field theory and quantum transport for hard photons
arxiv-2407-18091.creator: Marc Comadran 1,2,3, Cristina Manuel 1,2
arxiv-2407-18091.description: Abstract We develop an effective field theory for the description of high energetic or hard photons, the on-shell effective theory (OSEFT). The OSEFT describes the so called eikonal or semi-classical optical limit, allowing for corrections organized in a systematic expansion on inverse powers of the photon energy.

arxiv-2506-08289.title: Stereographic Projections on Some Quadric Surfaces Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author.
arxiv-2506-08289.creator: W.F.C. Barboza ∗ , T.F. Cruz and R.B. Leal
arxiv-2506-08289.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by W.F.C. Barboza ∗ , T.F. Cruz and R.B. Leal. In this work, we present an adaptation of the classical stereographic projection, originally formulated for the sphere, now considering the context of the ellipsoid and the elliptic paraboloid. We begin by constructing the stereographic projections for both quadric surfaces separately, analyzing the geometric particularities of each surface and the challenges arising from their variable curvatures and, in the case of the paraboloid, its non-compactness.

arxiv-2507-14443.title: Multi-Wavelength Dust Characterization of the HL Tau Disk and Implications for Planet Formation Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2507-14443.creator: Takahiro Ueda, Sean M. Andrews, Carlos Carrasco-González, Osmar M. Guerra-Alvarado, Satoshi Okuzumi, Ryo Tazaki, Akimasa Kataoka
arxiv-2507-14443.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Takahiro Ueda, Sean M. Andrews, Carlos Carrasco-González, Osmar M. Guerra-Alvarado, Satoshi Okuzumi, Ryo Tazaki, Akimasa Kataoka. We present a comprehensive analysis of the HL Tau dust disk by modeling its intensity profiles across six wavelengths (0.45 to 7.9 mm) with a resolution of 0 . ′′ \farcs 05 ( ∼ 7 \sim 7 au). Using a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) approach, we constrain key dust properties including temperature, surface density, maximum grain size, composition, filling factor, and size distribution.

pmc-10482802.title: A case of primary mesenteric synovial sarcoma: a challenging presentation
pmc-10482802.creator: Nihed Abdessayed, Malek Barka, Samiha Mabrouk, Zeineb Nfikha, Zeineb Maatoug, Yosra Fejji, Mohamed Salah Jarrar, Sabri Youssef, Moncef Mokni
pmc-10482802.description: BackgroundSynovial sarcoma is an uncommon soft tissue malignancy that mainly occurs near tendon sheath and bone joints. Primary intra-abdominal location is exceedingly rare and characterized by non-specific clinical signs.Case presentationWe report the case of a young female without medical history who presented with acute abdominopelvic pain.

pmc-11283727.title: 2-Bromo-1,4-Naphthalenedione promotes CD8+ T cell expansion and limits Th1/Th17 to mitigate experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis
pmc-11283727.creator: Cuixia Yang, Yuanchen Ma, Qiying Lu, Yuliang Qu, Yuantao Li, Shimei Cheng, Chongjun Xiao, Jinshuo Chen, Chuangjia Wang, Feng Wang, Andy Peng Xiang, Weijun Huang, Xiaorong Tang, Haiqing Zheng
pmc-11283727.description: Treating Multiple sclerosis (MS), a well-known immune-mediated disease characterized by axonal demyelination, is challenging due to its complex causes. Naphthalenedione, present in numerous plants, is being explored as a potential medicine for MS due to its immunomodulatory properties. However, its effects on lymphocytes can vary depending on factors such as the specific compound, concentration, and experimental conditions.

pmc-11656835.title: Hybrid Nanoparticle Engineered with Transforming Growth Factor -β1-Overexpressed Extracellular Vesicle and Cartilage-Targeted Anti-Inflammatory Liposome for Osteoarthritis
pmc-11656835.creator: Jun Yong Kim, Won-Kyu Rhim, Seung Yeon Lee, Jung Min Park, Duck Hyun Song, Seung-Gyu Cha, Sang-Hyuk Lee, Dong-Youn Hwang, Byoung Ju Kim, Seungsoo Rho, Tae-Keun Ahn, Chun Gwon Park, Dong Keun Han
pmc-11656835.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) possess the characteristics of their parent cells, based on which various studies have actively investigated treatments for diseases using mesenchymal stem cell-derived EVs due to their regenerative activity. Furthermore, in recent years, there have been significant efforts to engineer EVs to improve their native activities and integrate additional functions.

pmc-12491149.title: SREBP1-SCD1 enhanced MUFAs Biosynthesis drives Nutrient Deprived Pancreatic cancer cell Ferroptosis Resistance
pmc-12491149.creator: Zhengyang Zhang, Xiaojie Cai, Yi Gong, Aihua Gong, Xiang Liao, Jie Gao, Dongqing Wang
pmc-12491149.description: Background: As the most disastrous tumor microenvironment of pancreatic cancer, nutrient deprivation determined various cancer cell biology, especially the cell death resistance. Our objective is to elucidate the role of nutrient deprivation in ferroptosis resistance of pancreatic cancer cells and to explore potential therapeutic strategies to overcome it.

pmc-12555865.title: Health Economic Modeling for Policy Simulation
pmc-12555865.creator: S Ali
pmc-12555865.description: Economic models are powerful tools for simulating the long-term return on investment of policy interventions, making them ideal for examining both health outcomes and costs over extended periods. In this workshop, we will present a case study of policy simulation using the example of a menthol cigarette ban.

pmc-12566522.title: Recent Advances in the Role of Bacteriophages in the Aetiology and Therapy of Vaginal Dysbiosis in the Form of Bacterial Vaginosis and the Prevention of Preterm Birth
pmc-12566522.creator: Ronald F. Lamont, Amaan Ali, Jan Stener Jørgensen
pmc-12566522.description: Bacterial vaginosis is more than a mild inconvenience for women and has been shown to be an important cause of morbidity and mortality in women through sexually transmitted infections, and in babies due to late miscarriage and preterm birth. The aetiology of bacterial vaginosis remains unclear but there is increasing evidence to support sexual transmission as a cause.

pmc-12727776.title: Dietary differences amplify the water stress impacts of virtual water trade in the yellow river basin
pmc-12727776.creator: Dandan Ren, Huiran Mao, Dengpan Xiao, Yang Lu, Xiaoren Xu, Qingtao Ma, Liang Wang
pmc-12727776.description: Understanding the implications of dietary consumption and food trade for water resources is essential for sustainable development in water-scarce regions. In this study, we quantified the dietary virtual water use (DVWU) and trade flows associated with food production and consumption across the upstream, midstream, and downstream regions of the Yellow River Basin (YRB), with explicit consideration of urban–rural dietary differences.

pmc-12853763.title: Elderly welfare programs and depressive symptoms in China: cross-sectional evidence from CHARLS 2020
pmc-12853763.creator: Hui Yang, Zhan Shu
pmc-12853763.description: BackgroundThere is limited evidence in China regarding the relationship between welfare programs and the depressive symptoms of the older adults. This study aims to explore the relationships between three different welfare programs and the depressive symptoms of older adults and to compare the potential pathways through which family support and social participation may operate.

pmc-13159385.title: Physiological–Biochemical Characteristics and a Transcriptomic Profiling Analysis Reveal the Postharvest Wound Healing Mechanisms of Sweet Potatoes under Ascorbic Acid Treatment
pmc-13159385.creator: Hongxia Xuan, Jiyu Cheng, Linjiang Pang, Liqing Yin, Yuge Guan, Junfeng Cheng, Xinghua Lu, Guoquan Lu
pmc-13159385.description: Sweet potatoes are extremely vulnerable to mechanical wounds during harvesting and postharvest handling. It is highly necessary to take measures to accelerate wound healing. The effect of 20 g L−1 of ascorbic acid (AA) treatment on the wound healing of sweet potatoes and its mechanisms were studied.

pmc-13315138.creator: Jiawei Zhao, Rui Zhao, Yuzhu Chen, Lina Cui, Xianqin Ma, Tong Lin, Fuhong Dong, Jiawen Chen, Jinfeng Tan, Tianyu Wu, Zhao Sun, Chengmei Jin, Lili Xiu, Wei Wang, Huai Yu, Yanchao Liu, Guo Wei, Lulu Li, Yini Wang, Jingbo Hou, Chao Fang, Jiannan Dai, Bo Yu

pmc-13431483.title: The Paradox of Availability: A Quantitative Analysis of Veterinary Medicinal Products for Aquaculture in Europe Between 2018 and 2026
pmc-13431483.creator: Lauren Chambers, Wiebke Jansen, Dušan Palić, Andrea Fabris, Alain Schonbrodt, Leona Nepejchalová, Nancy De Briyne
pmc-13431483.description: Simple SummaryAvailability of veterinary medicinal products (VMPs) is a critical determinant of health, welfare, and economic sustainability in European aquaculture. This study assessed the development in the authorization and reported market availability of veterinary medicines for finfish in the European Union and European Free Trade Association between 2018 and 2026.

pmc-13620018.title: Targeting thioredoxin reductase for anti-tuberculosis drug discovery: the inhibitor OSSL_632214
pmc-13620018.creator: Qiyue Jia, Jinghua Shi, Yangxue Ye, Bin Wang, Yu Lu
pmc-13620018.description: The persistent prevalence of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (TB) and extensively drug-resistant TB has progressively undermined the efficacy of TB infection control measures. Thus, developing innovative drugs that act on novel Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) targets is a strategic priority for global TB control efforts. This research direction offers a robust, evidence-based solution to the urgent, growing challenge of anti-TB drug resistance.
